prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the Shinsengumi swordsman's CHUDAN rear battle sprite in reference 1. Reference 2 shows the same sprite at larger source resolution for pixel/costume detail. Reference 3 is the overworld source sheet: use its loose outer haori construction, not its camera or small body proportions.
Make TWO corrections: (1) Add a clear white Shinsengumi back emblem, the single Japanese kanji 誠, centered on the upper back of the blue haori between the shoulder blades; render it as bold readable white pixel strokes following the cloth perspective, no circle or rectangle behind it. (2) Correct the haori so it hangs as a loose open outer jacket from the shoulders down over the hips, with broad straight draping back panels and small natural folds. Remove the pinched/gathered waist and blue waist tie/bow that currently make the haori look belted like a kimono. Any obi belongs UNDER the jacket. Keep the white sawtooth trim on the sleeves and existing lower edges. Allow the scabbard to emerge naturally from under the loose haori at the left hip.
STRICT INVARIANTS: same rear three-quarter camera facing upper-right, identical head/hair/face, same two-handed Chudan grip, same drawn katana and blade angle, same feet/sandals and striped hakama, same stance, same blue palette and crisp pixel clusters, body size and foot position. No extra swords, no extra hands, no added animation effects. Entire sword and full body inside frame. Preserve transparent background. Exactly one isolated full-body sprite. Intended final export remains 480x384, body crown-to-sole 280px, sole baseline y368, foot center x240. Match reference sprite style; do not introduce painterly softness. Output the corrected sprite with true alpha transparency, no ground shadow, lettering other than the single back emblem, grid, labels or backdrop.
